name: wf1_wide_multifile
stressor: WIDE cross-file propagation (co-residency): one core concept (the rollout value field/param/key name `rollout_percentage`) must be renamed to `rollout_pct` and the change propagated to EVERY call site across 7+ interdependent files, keeping behavior byte-for-byte identical, without touching deliberately-similar distractor names.
source_note: Purpose-built `rollout` package (7 modules: model.py, rules.py, engine.py, config.py, report.py, service.py, hashing.py + __init__.py) plus flags.json, demo.py, README.md, authored for this benchmark. The single identifier `rollout_percentage` appears as a dataclass field, function/method parameters, kwargs at call sites, a JSON config key (in config.py AND flags.json), conditional reads, and a reported field -- spread across 6 .py files (model, rules, engine, config, report, service) and the JSON. The rename `rollout_percentage` -> `rollout_pct` is a PURE name change (still int 0..100, behavior identical). Distractors that must NOT change: `bucket_percentage` (hashing.py helper), `sample_percentage` (config/service audit knob), and the English word 'percentage' in prose/help text. No bug is planted -- the seed app runs correctly; the task is consistent wide propagation, not localized debugging.
discriminator: This stresses WORKING-SET CO-RESIDENCY across many files: a coherent rename must be applied identically at ~15 call sites scattered over 6 .py files plus the JSON key, and the oracle greps that ZERO occurrences of the old name `rollout_percentage` remain in ANY .py file while `rollout_pct` is actually used, AND runs the app end-to-end on unseen flags/users/configs. A bounded-slice agent keeps all touched files co-resident in its working set and stays consistent, while a growing-transcript agent must re-derive the full call-site set repeatedly and tends to (a) miss a site in one module (engine kwarg, rules parameter, report field, or the JSON key), leaving the old name and breaking from_dict/to_dict round-tripping, or (b) over-apply a blanket find-replace and corrupt the `bucket_percentage`/`sample_percentage` distractors -- both of which the oracle catches.
